answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 45787 Country: India Title: Market Research Question: I am working in leading BPO as a Market Research Analyst. We are working on Europe market research and basically deal with the FMCG (Fast Moving Consumer Products) products, out of this, 5-10% of products are alcoholic beverages, on which we are doing market research through database ( Previous Sales data). So I wanted to know that is it valid as per Shariah or not? If not so what we should do? I would also like to clarify that we are not selling or promoting directly, we are just doing market research on the basis of their previous year’s sales data. Kindly guide us for the same. Answer ID: 45787 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 896/686/D=1434) As per the details mentioned in the question, there is no harm in the work of market research. This job and its salary are lawful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
